response.overview: Three close friends, Hakim (Niezam Zaidi), Junaidi (Iedil Dzuhrie Alaudin) and Wan (Akmal Asyraf), are determined to climb Mount Jerai to perform a forbidden ritual. They are drawn to the existence of a mysterious stone believed to be capable of granting any human desire. From that night onwards, their lives change completely. Success comes unexpectedly, as if some supernatural force is constantly fulfilling their every dream. However, all this wealth and pleasure comes at an extremely high price. Gradually, mysterious disturbances begin to haunt their lives and the situation becomes increasingly dark day by day. At the same time, Wan disappears without any word. Years later, a new tragedy strikes when Hakim's young daughter, Laila (Kis Aisha), is afflicted with a strange illness that defies all logic. Desperate and consumed by guilt, Hakim decides to return to Mount Jerai with Junaidi, hoping to correct the mistakes they once made.
response.title: Keramat Gunung Jerai
